source.section: TC-40 lines 4 to 22 (Instructions PDF p.9 Line 4; PDF p.10 Lines 5 to 20 and the Line 17 table; PDF p.11 Line 22)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 60,000.00 = 60,000.00. Federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - standard deduction 23,625.00 = 36,375.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; Utah starts from federal AGI). TC-40 (head of household): line 4 federal AGI 60,000.00. Line 5 additions: none, 0.00. Line 6 = 60,000.00 + 0.00 = 60,000.00. Line 7 state tax refund 0.00. Line 8 subtractions 0.00. Line 9 Utah taxable income = 60,000.00 - 0.00 - 0.00 = 60,000.00. Line 10 = 60,000.00 x 0.045 = 2,700.00. Lines 11 to 16, by the projection: no dependents; the deduction on line 12 is held as the cap 23,625.00; initial credit = 0.06 x min(line 9 60,000.00, cap 23,625.00) = 0.06 x 23,625.00 = 1,417.50. Line 17 base phase-out amount 27,320.00. Line 18 = max(0, 60,000.00 - 27,320.00) = 32,680.00. Line 19 = 32,680.00 x 0.013 = 424.840. Line 20 = max(0, 1,417.50 - 424.840) = 992.660. Line 21 worksheet: line 1 federal AGI 60,000.00; line 2 standard deduction 23,625.00; line 3 senior deduction 0.00 (no amount in Utah's sources); line 4 23,625.00; line 5 = max(0, 60,000.00 - 23,625.00) = 36,375.00. Line 5 is above zero, so not exempt; line 21 blank. Line 22 and TC-40A Part 3: line 20 992.660 = 992.660; credits 992.66. Tax = 2,700.00 - 992.66 = 1,707.34.
